hubstaff_bill_rate.description: Never send pay_rate to QBO. Do not copy tracker rate columns into QBO writes.

client_name.description: Tracker DBA: Client List column Client Name

legal_business_name.description: Tracker Legal Business Name (QBO customer legal name candidate)

va_name.description: Tracker VA Name (from-tracker.csv; one row per VA assignment)

va_number.description: Parsed from VA Name (VA# / VA #). Maps toward qbo_va_number once Matt confirms.

expected_hours.description: Tracker Expected Hours Worked. Sparsely filled on Client List.

actual_hours.description: Tracker Actual Hours Worked. On Client List this currently holds contracted weekly hours (20/40), not last-week Hubstaff actuals.

weekly_hours_col.description: Rolling weekly hours column header, e.g. HH061 (Aug 24-30). Source of truth for that week's billed hours once populated.

weekly_hours_value.description: Value in the current weekly hours column. Empty on ingest week of 2026-08-26.

tracker_sheet_row.description: Row number on Client List tab (for audit, not a billing key)

tracker_rate_columns_never_write.description: TRACKER-ONLY / NEVER WRITE TO QBO: VA Hourly Rate to Client, VA Hourly Rate to HH PH, VAs Hourly Net Pay, Onboarding Fee. Named here so they are not copied into mapping CSVs or QBO payloads.
